title: View History Logs OFF: work order history and line history are hidden (work orders only)
preconds:
1. A user has a role with the View History Logs toggle OFF but enough access to open work orders and lines.
  2. A work order has at least one line, both with some change history.

Will be updated after a followup ticket is completed for this https://shopview.atlassian.net/browse/SV-8202
steps:
1. Open the work order and look for the work order history / audit log.
  2. Open a line and look for the line's history.
expected:
With View History Logs off, both the work order history and the line history are hidden.

<p>This toggle applies to work orders only. Part Sales has no history feature.</p>
<p>Part (inventory) history is a separate feature: it is reached under Parts > Inventory by clicking the clock icon next to a part (tooltip 'Part History').</p>
